annotation.title_clean: 「ガバメント AI 源内」商標およびブランドガイドライン
annotation.title_en: Trademark and Brand Guidelines for "Government AI Genai"
annotation.summary_en: Japan Digital Agency's brand guideline for the "Government AI Genai" generative AI environment. It separates copyright licensing from trademark/brand use and sets permitted name and logo uses by user category (ministries, municipalities, corporations, individuals, third parties), modification degree and provision mode, with mandatory disclaimers to prevent misattribution of government endorsement.
key_provisions_or_claims: Copyright licence (OSS) is separate from permission to use the name and official logo.
Descriptive references to Genai OSS use are allowed without permission if not implying government endorsement.
Derivatives must have their own names and may not incorporate 'Genai' in the name.
Use of the official name must carry the operating entity's name; matrix of permitted uses by user category.
Standard notices and anti-confusion disclaimers required; Digital Agency contact desk handles inquiries and misuse reports.
